description: A boy with short hair and a dark sweater leans over a wooden table in a dim room, pushing a black cable into a green circuit board with a silver-cased chip and small ports, a Raspberry Pi-style board. Beside it sit a beige keyboard, a bulky CRT monitor with a glowing screen, and a tangle of cables including a yellow RCA plug. A second child sits at a desk in the blurred background in front of a dark chalkboard. The style is an oil painting with visible brushwork, and the scene is edge to edge with no frame.
